sloka: ततो ऽभ्यनन्दन् संहृष्टाः समरे हरियूथपाः।तमप्रतिबलं दृष्ट्वा हतं नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवम् ।। ६.९१.९३ ।।
transliteration: tato 'bhyanandan saṁhṛṣṭāḥ samare hariyūthapāḥ।tamapratibalaṁ dṛṣṭvā hataṁ nairṛtapuṅgavam ।। 6.91.93 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana and Hanuman, leader of Bears Jambavan praised Lakshmana and greeted him for his victory.
